name: Mission Bit Free Coding Classes
what_you_do: Free semester-long coding and computer science classes for high schoolers, in person or remote, plus workshops, self-paced courses and events.
who_can_apply: Ages 14 to 18 (high school). Priority goes to youth underrepresented in tech, students at high schools with few or no computer science classes, and girls and LGBTQIA+ youth. Online classes are for San Francisco students only.
duration: Semester long. Fall 2026 classes ran Sep 8 to Dec 4, 2026.
deadline_text: Fall 2026 class registration is closed. Spring 2027 classes are not posted yet. Workshops and events are posted separately (College Connections is Nov 7, 2026).
how_to_apply: Pick a class and register on the Mission Bit Classes page when registration opens.
notes: Mission Bit's Tech Start career prep is ages 18 to 26, not for most high schoolers. College Connections (Nov 7, 2026, 10:30 a.m. to noon at Chase Center, grades 9 to 12) closes registration Oct 27, 2026 per sf.gov.
